documents: The deployment pipeline promotes a build to staging only after the reproducibility gate passes on both x86 and ARM runners.
Nightly index compaction runs at 03:00 UTC and rewrites the segment manifest in place.
Retention policy for raw telemetry is 30 days; aggregated rollups are kept for 18 months.

Postmortem for the 2026-02-11 outage:
Root cause was a stale connection pool after the failover.
- pool health checks were advisory only
- the reconnect backoff was unbounded
